players.name: Egor Demin
players.detail: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

players.name: Day'Ron Sharpe
players.detail: Sharpe registered 15 points (5-7 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 13 rebounds and four assists across 26 minutes in Sunday's 98-90 win over the Pacers.

players.name: Nic Claxton
players.detail: Claxton (hamstring) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.

players.name: Jalen Smith
players.detail: Smith (finger) is probable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

players.name: Tobe Awaka
players.detail: Awaka (knee) is questionable for Sundays' game against the 76ers.

players.name: Zach Collins
players.detail: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

players.name: Sergio de Larrea
players.detail: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

players.name: Dereck Lively II
players.detail: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

players.name: Tarik Biberovic
players.detail: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

players.name: Jalen Duren
players.detail: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Isaiah Joe
players.detail: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lakers.

players.name: Isaac Jones
players.detail: Jones posted 18 points (6-14 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 3-3 FT), 10 rebounds, an assist, two steals and two blocks in Wednesday's 100-88 Summer League loss to the Suns.

players.name: Elijah Harkless
players.detail: Harkless signed a two-way contract with the Pistons, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.

players.name: Brandon Ingram
players.detail: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jordan Miller
players.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

players.name: Isaiah Jackson
players.detail: Jackson (groin) won't suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Bradley Beal
players.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

players.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
players.detail: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

players.name: Luka Doncic
players.detail: Doncic (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pistons.

players.name: Anthony Edwards
players.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

players.name: Donte DiVincenzo
players.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Joan Beringer
players.detail: Beringer (nose) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jazz.

players.name: Yves Missi
players.detail: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

players.name: Joel Embiid
players.detail: Embiid (foot) is probable for Sunday's game against the Bulls.

players.name: Dominick Barlow
players.detail: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

players.name: Ariel Hukporti
players.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Adem Bona
players.detail: Bona (back) is out for Sunday's game in Chicago.

players.name: Maxime Raynaud
players.detail: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

players.name: De'Andre Hunter
players.detail: Hunter (illness) is listed as out for Friday's game against San Antonio.

players.name: Keegan Murray
players.detail: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

players.name: Ben Simmons
players.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

players.name: Lauri Markkanen
players.detail: Markkanen is questionable for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right wrist sprain.

players.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
players.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Jusuf Nurkic
players.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.
